VoidAuthorization. checkout calls this with key &lt;sessionId&gt;:void, and only after a definitive rejection of the place-order step (never while the outcome is in doubt; that side is guarded by checkout's ErrPlacementInDoubt). VoidUnboundAuthorizations also voids an authorization that no CheckoutCompleted bound within 24 h.
